svg.title: Valdara Industries, Serra 180 – Exploded assembly (VI-DWG-B180-004)
svg.text: 1 Set the side frames (1) over the four ground anchors; check spacing
1600 mm between frame centres with a slat (2).
2 Level on the anchor nuts to the seat height; tighten the anchors.
3 Lay the three seat slats and two back slats; push the carriage
bolts (3, stainless A2) through slat and flange; washer (4) and
nut (5) under the flange; tighten to 10 N m. Grout under the feet.
4 Yearly: retighten the slat bolts; touch up the coating.
